reviewer: research subagent assistant; not independent human review
review_method: Read sealed holdout rubric and all 40 cases after frozen selection; reviewed every actual turn, call, fixture and post-tool reply. Full-turn grounded correctness; no keyword-only credit. Actual-history questions fairly credit acknowledging absent retrieval or the actual wrong-call fixture. Assistant review, not human review; no tuning.

faithful_post_tool_summaries.scope: Actual accepted-fixture fidelity only, irrespective of requested call correctness. Manually judged cases 31,33,36 faithful;38 fabricates466 for64. Cases without accepted fixture and summary excluded.
